dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-grey punctate blobs without internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the anterior neck region and along the lower lateral margins where full rings have not formed.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three large macro-annuli on the upper posterior flank form an obtuse triangle; an additional linear sequence of four smaller annuli runs parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Two vertical linear occlusions are present where foreground vegetation intersects the subject: one across the head/neck region and one across the posterior flank.
